title: Dortai

paragraphs: In Pesachim 70b: Yehudah ben Dortai. Yehudah also had a son named Dortai; Hyman places them in Hillel’s time, and says that he went with his father and settled in the South.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The final “he” most naturally refers to Dortai, who accompanied his father Yehudah.

Pesachim 70b explicitly mentions Yehudah ben Dortai and Dortai his son withdrawing to the South; it also mentions Shemaya and Avtalyon. Hyman supplies the placement in Hillel’s time. The three-generation naming and the final pronoun are preserved without adding a family identification.
